data.body: HOLISTIC-REVIEW FINDING I4 (opus audit, 2026-06-03) — MQ-4 follow-up: wait-for-pr.sh eviction detection is correct (tracks autoMergeRequest non-null->null + mergeStateStatus BLOCKED/DIRTY/BEHIND to name a queue eviction), but the 'queued-behind another sprint' case (ADR friction G5/G8) is governed solely by --timeout (default 3600s). Under parallel-worktree contention, a sprint serialized behind others can exceed 1h of healthy queued-behind wait and hit timeout->exit 1->re-enqueue loop. Follow-up (fold into MQ-6a verification): for the MQ path either raise the default timeout materially OR extend/reset the deadline while autoMergeRequest is present and mergeStateStatus indicates a healthy queue position, so a long-but-progressing queue wait is not false-failed. Verdict on MQ-4 itself: SOUND — flag-gating well-localized (single read, 3 gated points), flag-OFF byte-invariant, version bump correct at max-PRs-per-merge=1 (commits pre-push so the queued candidate is never stale).
